item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00448","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C10","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C17 is a strong drafting antecedent because it directs federal procurement and related programs toward localities with serious unemployment—the precise policy mechanism endorsed in the child—and asks agency officials to communicate and implement that policy. The child compresses and updates this machinery for defense procurement, adds favorable tax treatment for new defense plants, and requires periodic reporting. C10 and C23 contain related defense-production location machinery, but their primary rationales are industrial dispersion and manpower allocation rather than relief of economically distressed areas.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"increase the number of defense contracts that are placed in areas where there has been a large amount of unemployment","parent_excerpt":"Federal programs ... can be timed and channeled so as to concentrate upon areas where unemployment is heavy ... particularly applicable to procurement and construction activities","explanation":"Both make the geographic placement of federal procurement a tool for relieving concentrated unemployment."},{"child_excerpt":"communicate my views on this matter to all procurement officials","parent_excerpt":"cooperation ... in taking actions to modify ... the procurement, construction, and other activities of your agency ... in order to alleviate serious unemployment in particular localities","explanation":"Both presidential communications direct responsible agency personnel to implement the procurement policy within existing administrative channels."},{"child_excerpt":"provide me with periodic reports on the results achieved under the two directives","parent_excerpt":"directing that a continuing review of such activities be undertaken within the Executive Office, in order to coordinate planning ... and their geographic distribution","explanation":"Both couple geographically targeted procurement with continuing presidential-level oversight, though the child states the reporting requirement more explicitly."}]}
